_note: Per-product English for everything that comes out of the Korean deck: spec values, the one-liner, and the [features & benefits] block. Brief text lives in briefs.json, the longer write-ups in etc.json.
_rules: Write for a creator on camera, not for a regulator. Short sentences.
Never invent a claim the deck does not make.
Keep every hedge the Korean carries: immediate, temporary, individual variation.
No prices, no launch dates, no manufacturer, no certificate numbers.

스펙.타겟: All hair types, damaged hair, dry hair

italian-white-truffle-professional-repai.한줄: A hair perfume serum that layers shine and moisture at once — an angel-ring finish with a scent that builds as you spray.

특징.title: Oil and serum blended 3:7 for shine and moisture
body: Pink oil 30% for the angel-ring shine, moisturising serum 70% for softness and water.
The oil coats and the serum hydrates, layered together in that ratio, for hair that stays glossy without feeling heavy.

특징.title: A fine mist that lands like a feather — no clumping, no greasy strands
body: The mist is fine enough to settle evenly, so you can reuse it through the day without weighing hair down.
The more you layer it, the more the scent develops.

특징.title: 55% collagen water and 10% Peptide Exosome for conditioning
body: A nano exosome system drawn from Italian white truffle, bound to 99% pure low-molecular Dipeptide-15.
d'Alba describes the particle as 467× smaller than a pore — a comparison drawn from an outside paper's average, not a measurement of this product.
It smooths roughened hair so the active spreads evenly along the strand.

특징.title: Rose Freesia — the scent that sets the mood
body: Fresh fruit opens, then rose and freesia bloom through the middle.
A soft musk closes it, drifting whenever your hair moves.

특징.title: Protein and oil for hair that has gone dry and brittle
body: d'Alba proprietary ingredients — Peptide Exosome™ (Dipeptide-15 1.2%, white truffle water and extract) for conditioning, Trufferol™ (Italian white truffle and tocopherol) for bounce.
Moisture and shine: d'Alba-9 Blending Oil with baobab seed oil and apricot kernel oil.

특징.title: Italian V-Label vegan certified · primary skin irritation test completed in Korea
body: Raw materials chosen carefully, no sulphate surfactants — gentle enough for frequent use.
